title: Fake SASSA SMS Requesting Banking Details
description: Scammers send SMS messages claiming to be from SASSA, asking beneficiaries to update their banking details by clicking a link or replying with personal information. These messages often create urgency by claiming grants will be suspended.
indicators: Creates false urgency about grant suspension
Asks for PIN numbers or passwords
prevention: SASSA will never ask for banking details via SMS. Always verify through official channels: 0800 60 10 11 or www.sassa.gov.za
examples: URGENT: Your SASSA grant will be suspended. Update banking details at [suspicious link]
SASSA ALERT: Confirm your bank details by replying with account number and PIN

title: Fake SASSA Officials Collecting Fees
description: Fraudsters pose as SASSA officials in communities, especially rural areas, claiming they can help with grant applications for a fee. They may wear fake uniforms or carry fake identification.
indicators: Claims to be SASSA official without proper ID
Cannot provide official SASSA office details
prevention: All SASSA services are FREE. Real officials work from official offices and never collect fees. Report suspicious individuals to police and SASSA.
examples: Pay R500 and I'll process your grant application faster
I'm from SASSA head office, give me R200 to update your details

title: WhatsApp Grant Application Scam
description: Scammers create fake WhatsApp groups or contacts claiming to help with SASSA applications. They request personal documents and may ask for money to 'guarantee' approval.
indicators: Unofficial WhatsApp numbers claiming to be SASSA
Requests copies of ID documents and personal info
Asks for upfront payments or fees
Uses unofficial SASSA logos or branding
prevention: Only use official SASSA WhatsApp number: 082 046 8553. Never send ID copies to unknown contacts or pay for applications.
examples: Send R300 and your ID copy for guaranteed SRD approval
Join our SASSA WhatsApp group for fast grant processing

title: Fake SASSA Loan Offers
description: Criminals send messages offering loans against SASSA grants, claiming beneficiaries can borrow money that will be deducted from future grant payments. These are illegal and often involve identity theft.
indicators: Requests SASSA card details or PIN
prevention: SASSA does not offer loans. Never share your SASSA card details or PIN. Report loan scams to SASSA and police immediately.
examples: Get R5000 loan against your SASSA grant - no credit check needed
Borrow money now, we'll deduct from your next SASSA payment

title: Fraudulent SASSA Websites
description: Fake websites that look like official SASSA sites are used to steal personal information. These sites may offer grant applications or status checks but are designed to harvest data.
indicators: Poor website design or broken links
Asks for payment for free services
prevention: Only use official SASSA websites: www.sassa.gov.za and srd.sassa.gov.za. Check the URL carefully and look for .gov.za domain.
examples: www.sassa-grants.co.za (fake site)
www.sassaonline.com (fake site)

title: SRD Grant Approval Fee Scam
description: Scammers contact people whose SRD applications were declined, claiming they can help get approval for a fee. They may have access to some personal information to appear legitimate.
indicators: Claims to have inside connections at SASSA
Knows some personal details about your application
prevention: SRD appeals are free through the official website. SASSA staff will never call requesting payments. Use only official appeal process.
examples: Pay R1000 and I'll get your SRD approved through my SASSA contacts
Your appeal was declined, but I can help for R500

title: Fake SASSA Card Replacement Scam
description: Fraudsters target people with lost or damaged SASSA cards, offering replacement services for a fee. They may operate near SASSA offices to appear legitimate.
indicators: Offers card replacement services outside SASSA offices
Claims faster service than official process
prevention: Card replacements are done only at official SASSA offices. Some fees may apply, but payment is made to SASSA directly, not individuals.
examples: Get your new SASSA card today for R200 - no waiting
I work with SASSA, pay me R150 for express card replacement

title: Grant Increase Notification Scam
description: Scammers send messages claiming SASSA grants have been increased and beneficiaries need to 'activate' the increase by providing personal information or paying a fee.
indicators: Claims about grant increases not announced officially
Requests activation fees or personal details
Creates urgency about missing out on increases
prevention: Grant increases are announced officially by government. No activation is required. Check official SASSA channels for real announcements.
examples: Your SASSA grant increased to R3000! Pay R100 activation fee to claim
URGENT: Activate your grant increase by sending ID number to this number

title: Fake Disability Grant Medical Assessment
description: Criminals pose as medical professionals offering to help with disability grant medical assessments for payment, or claim they can influence the assessment outcome.
indicators: Offers to help with medical assessments for money
Claims to guarantee disability grant approval
prevention: Medical assessments are done by qualified doctors at designated facilities. No one can guarantee approval outcomes. Report fake medical professionals to authorities.
examples: Pay R2000 and I'll make sure you pass your disability assessment
I'm a SASSA doctor, give me R1500 to approve your disability grant

title: Child Support Grant Document Fraud
description: Fraudsters offer to help obtain or create false documents needed for Child Support Grant applications, such as fake birth certificates or affidavits.
indicators: Offers to create or obtain false documents
Claims to have connections at Home Affairs
Cannot provide official documentation for services
prevention: Only use official documents from proper government departments. Using false documents is illegal and will result in grant cancellation and criminal charges.
examples: Need a birth certificate? I can get you one for R800
Pay R500 and I'll create the affidavit you need for your child grant
